{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing flipper_length_mm
penguins_clean = penguins.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Compute mean flipper length by species
mean_flipper_by_species = penguins_clean.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Sort by mean flipper length in descending order
mean_flipper_by_species_sorted = mean_flipper_by_species.sort_values(ascending=False)

# Get the species with the highest mean
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_by_species_sorted.index[0]

# Print results
print("Mean flipper length by species:")
print(mean_flipper_by_species_sorted)

print(f"\nSpecies with highest mean flipper length: {highest_mean_species}")"}
